turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Sure! First, I will show you how I think.
I want to say "___ hat". The first sound of "hat" is "h". That is not a vowel sound, so I choose "a": He wears a hat.
The rule: use "an" before a vowel sound, and "a" before other sounds.
Right: I found an egg. Wrong: I found a egg.

Now you try. Write just the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
